lines.21: 「Now you've made me mad. If that's how you want it, fine.」
lines.22: I picked up a stick lying on the beach.
lines.23: 「W-what... What are you going to do...?」
lines.24: 「Maybe you and I really just don't get along.」
lines.25: 「That's MY line! You're really getting on my nerves!」
lines.27: I drove the stick into the sand with a thunk.
lines.29: Then I scraped a line sideways through the sand.
lines.30: 「Don't cross this line! This side is my territory!」
lines.31: 「YOU are really going to say that!?」
lines.32: 「Then I'll do it too! From here...」
lines.33: Konoe grabbed a stick and started scratching a line through the sand.
lines.35: 「This side of the line is my territory!」
lines.42: I drew a line parallel to the water's edge.
lines.43: 「Everything past this line! The whole ocean is my territory!」
lines.44: 「Idiot! In a situation like this, the mountains beat the sea.」
lines.45: 「Then the whole mountain is my territory!」
lines.54: 「This pier is mine! When the boat comes, you won't be allowed on!」
lines.57: I had no idea what she was supposed to be apologizing for.
lines.59: 「Times like this call for the peanut-butter bread I brought as a snack.」
lines.60: Konoe calmly took the convenience-store bread out of her bag and began eating.
lines.62: I silently observed this bizarre creature's habits.
lines.63: 「Peanut butter replenished! My head is clear again!」
lines.64: 「All right... I got it! I win!」
lines.66: It looked entertaining, so I followed her.
lines.68: Konoe planted herself triumphantly in front of the water source.
lines.69: 「Idiot! Even if you've got the pier, our ride isn't coming until tomorrow! Humans can't live without water!」
lines.70: 「If you want water, bring me food! Ahahahaha!」
lines.71: 「Or maybe you'll say you're sorry? Will you? Will you?」
lines.72: 「Come on... Stop screwing around and think seriously.」
lines.73: 「Why do you suddenly snap back to normal RIGHT THERE!?」
lines.74: I left Konoe flailing and started thinking.
lines.75: 「It's around noon... Either way, we need to find some food.」
lines.76: 「Let's at least get our food situation sorted out before dark.」
lines.77: 「I told you! I'm not taking handouts from you!」
lines.80: 「I'm pissed because you keep messing with me!」
lines.84: 「Then I'll show off all the food I find and eat it right in front of you!」
lines.85: With that, Konoe headed into the mountains.
lines.87: I admired her spirit, but was she going to be okay?
lines.88: I immediately opened the scroll the Principal had given me.
lines.89: We were in plenty of trouble already, after all.
lines.91: 「Whoa. It tells you what's edible, what isn't, and even how to gather it all!」
lines.92: So THAT was what the scroll contained.
lines.93: 「With this, it'll be easy. First up: tree fruit!」
lines.94: I mean, as long as we had water, we could survive until tomorrow evening without eating.
lines.95: But that would be rough on growing teenagers like us.
lines.96: Following the scroll, I decided to start with fruit from a palm(?) growing near the shore.
lines.97: Once I managed to climb the tree, getting it was easy.
